Name: Panty Time
Author: Acurizee
Description:
[color=#ff0000][size=4][b][i]Description[/i][/b][/size][/color]
Add panties to every bachelorette in the Valley, and optionally to Caroline with the Sweetheart mod.

[color=#00ffff][size=4][b][i]Installation instructions[/i][/b][/size][/color]
Just install it in your Mods folder.

[color=#00ff00][size=4][b][i]Main features[/i][/b][/size][/color]
Inspired by Lewis's shorts, my goal with this was to simply add the panties of the bachelorettes in Stardew Valley Vanilla. Currently, each of them has a letter that triggers a quest: the quest to collect their panties from specific, non-public locations associated with the character; the item itself; a special version made from one of their favorite items; special reactions when you give them the panties; and a special interaction when they give you the item in return.

The letter is sent when you have 8 hearts with your favorite character, plus 6 hearts with the letter senders. The item will appear on a specific tile out of four; I designed it this way so that NPCs wouldn’t break them while walking.

[size=4][b][color=#ffff00][i]Requirements[/i][/color][/b][/size]
You need BETAS for the items to appear.

FTM can't generate the items I need in the houses (yet); if I manage to get it to work, I'll change the requirement.

Manifest.Name: Panty Time
Manifest.Description: Add the panties of the sweetest bachelorettes in town.
